reserves.name: dTRINITY Staked dUSD deployed strategy positions

reserveReview.rationale: dTRINITY documents sdUSD as an ERC-4626 receipt whose dUSD is supplied into dLEND. The live deployed-position row is therefore classified as a dLEND protocol position with a tracked dUSD wrapper dependency. Unstaking is permissionless but depends on unutilized dLEND liquidity, so no fixed liquidity horizon is asserted.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Live ERC-4626 deployed-position observation on 2026-09-21 plus dTRINITY sdUSD and dLEND documentation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The dUSD dependency is identified at 100%, but dLEND market allocation, utilization, and available unstaking liquidity are dynamic.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The protocol identifies on-chain dSTAKE and dLEND contracts but does not establish legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, or rehypothecation treatment for dUSD supplied to lending markets.
